description_pt_br: Carga, utilidades e controladores permanecem em uma faixa estável com ruído físico pequeno.
injection_pattern: Blocos de 4 a 12 horas entre transições normais.
opcua_effect: Valores bons e cadência nominal.
current_analytical_coverage: CPM snapshot and Data Quality window health.

description_pt_br: A carga da planta muda em rampa e perturba unidades a jusante sem introduzir uma falha.
injection_pattern: Duas rampas por ciclo de 72 horas.
opcua_effect: Valores bons e timestamps regulares.
current_analytical_coverage: CPM snapshot records bounded tracking and variability facts.
future_method_or_protocol_need: None; this is a healthy comparison case.

description_pt_br: Ganho e ação integral excessivos produzem overshoot e reversões frequentes.
injection_pattern: Episode of 3 to 8 hours after a setpoint or load change.
opcua_effect: Good-quality values with physical oscillation.
current_analytical_coverage: CPM snapshot covers error and variability but does not identify tuning cause.

description_pt_br: Baixo ganho ou integral lenta mantém erro por tempo excessivo após uma mudança.
injection_pattern: Episode of 6 to 16 hours around one disturbance.
opcua_effect: Good-quality values with delayed recovery.
current_analytical_coverage: CPM snapshot covers error and variability.

description_pt_br: A dinâmica local e a sintonia mantêm uma oscilação periódica reprodutível.
injection_pattern: Episode of 4 to 12 hours with gradual onset and removal.
opcua_effect: Good-quality periodic values.
current_analytical_coverage: PV variability is covered; periodicity is not yet canonical.

description_pt_br: Uma oscilação de utilidade ou equipamento compartilhado aparece em outra variável com defasagem.
injection_pattern: Episode synchronized with one upstream driver.
opcua_effect: Good-quality correlated values.
current_analytical_coverage: Individual CPM Results remain independent.
future_method_or_protocol_need: Interaction Protocol with explicit secondary Signal Role.

description_pt_br: A posição real permanece em patamares até vencer uma banda de atrito e então se move em salto.
injection_pattern: Intermittent episodes with configurable friction band.
opcua_effect: OP remains smooth while valve feedback shows plateaus and jumps.
current_analytical_coverage: OP saturation and tracking facts may change; stiction is not directly detected.

description_pt_br: Reversões da demanda não alteram imediatamente a posição real do elemento final.
injection_pattern: Episode of 4 to 10 hours with direction-dependent dead band.
opcua_effect: Good-quality OP and final-element feedback diverge during reversals.
current_analytical_coverage: Current snapshot does not use final-element feedback.

description_pt_br: A demanda ou resposta física permanece próxima ao limite enquanto o erro persiste.
injection_pattern: Episode aligned with high or low plant demand.
opcua_effect: Good-quality values near 0 or 100 percent.
current_analytical_coverage: OP saturation and error are canonical CPM branches.
future_method_or_protocol_need: Optional valve-authority interpretation remains future work.

description_pt_br: O controlador é transferido para manual durante uma intervenção ou limitação operacional.
injection_pattern: One or more explicit intervals with recorded mode transitions.
opcua_effect: MODE changes to MAN while PV, SP, OP continue.
current_analytical_coverage: Manual-mode fraction is canonical.

description_pt_br: A referência muda repetidamente por campanha, razão ou intervenção operacional.
injection_pattern: Step or ramp changes every 20 to 90 minutes during one episode.
opcua_effect: Good-quality SP changes with traceable timestamps.
current_analytical_coverage: Current snapshot sees tracking effects but does not count interventions.

description_pt_br: Ruído de alta frequência é adicionado à medição sem equivalente no estado físico do processo.
injection_pattern: Episode with gradual increase and decrease in amplitude.
opcua_effect: Good-quality noisy values unless combined with a quality event.
current_analytical_coverage: PV variability is canonical but noise attribution is not.

description_pt_br: A medição se afasta lentamente do estado físico simulado e força compensação do controlador.
injection_pattern: Monotonic bias growth over 12 to 48 hours.
opcua_effect: Good-quality values with hidden measurement bias.
current_analytical_coverage: Data Quality can describe the available values but cannot infer calibration drift alone.

description_pt_br: O valor publicado permanece constante enquanto sinais relacionados continuam variando.
injection_pattern: Episode of 30 minutes to 6 hours.
opcua_effect: Good or uncertain quality depending on scenario variant.
current_analytical_coverage: Data Quality value integrity can identify low distinctness when configured.

description_pt_br: Nenhuma observação histórica é publicada durante intervalos determinísticos.
injection_pattern: Several short gaps plus one longer outage in 72 hours.
opcua_effect: Missing observations; no synthetic fill.
current_analytical_coverage: Data Quality sampling and availability Methods are canonical.

description_pt_br: A observação existe, mas carrega código de qualidade OPC UA ruim ou incerto.
injection_pattern: Bursts of 2 to 30 minutes.
opcua_effect: Bad or uncertain status code with original timestamps retained.
current_analytical_coverage: Data Quality source-quality and value-integrity Methods are canonical.

description_pt_br: Um nó fica temporariamente indisponível e volta sem reescrever o intervalo perdido.
injection_pattern: Outage of 5 to 90 minutes followed by recovery.
opcua_effect: BadNotConnected or timeout behavior plus a historical gap.
current_analytical_coverage: Data Quality and Source health facts cover the outage boundary.

description_pt_br: Amostras chegam com jitter, atrasos ou intervalos maiores do que a política esperada.
injection_pattern: Deterministic jitter and skipped publication slots.
opcua_effect: Source timestamps remain truthful; server timestamps expose delay.
current_analytical_coverage: Data Quality sampling integrity is canonical.

description_pt_br: Mudanças externas de vazão, composição ou utilidade deslocam a malha e exigem recuperação.
injection_pattern: Step, ramp, or pulse propagated through connected areas.
opcua_effect: Good-quality physical response across several signals.
current_analytical_coverage: CPM snapshot records tracking and variability facts without root-cause attribution.

description_pt_br: Uma variável de planta ou outra malha influencia a PV com atraso e ganho definidos.
injection_pattern: Shared driver active for 4 to 16 hours.
opcua_effect: Good-quality correlated observations on separate nodes.
current_analytical_coverage: Current independent Results remain valid but do not assert interaction.
future_method_or_protocol_need: Interaction Method with explicit secondary Signal Role.
